output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    if not pts: return out
    minr=min(r for r,c in pts); minc=min(c for r,c in pts)
    # characteristic broadening: mark the two rows where the object has its central horizontal bar
    # For this family, these are the rows immediately preceding the widest row, and the widest row.
    widths=[]
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        cs=[c for rr,c in pts if rr==r]
        widths.append((max(cs)-min(cs)+1 if cs else 0, min(cs) if cs else 999))
    widest=max(w for w,c in widths)
    wr=[r for r,(w,c) in enumerate(widths) if w==widest]
    anchor=wr[0]
    # target is two rows ending at the first maximum-width row when expansion occurs
    r2=anchor
    r1=anchor-1
    for c in range(minc-3,minc):
        if 0<=r1<len(out) and 0<=c<len(out[0]): out[r1][c]=2 if c!=minc-2 or True else 2
        if 0<=r2<len(out) and 0<=c<len(out[0]): out[r2][c]=2 if c!=minc-2 else 0
    return out"}
